title: •Wounded Wookiee
caption: •Wounded Wookiee (V)
game_text: If opponent’s character was just hit during battle, add one destiny to your total power (two if character was a Wookiee); take cards drawn this way into hand. OR If you just lost X Force to a Force drain, draw up to X cards from Reserve Deck.
lore: When blaster fire from the barge’s gun hit Chewie’s skiff, his leg was injured by shrapnel. This setback distracted the Rebels, causing them to momentarily lose their advantage.
